audience_profile: Senior engineers who use CDNs daily but may not know CloudFront's two cache tiers or how to verify a hit from the command line. They want precision and no hype.
learning_objective: Trace one CloudFront request: nearest edge location, regional edge cache, origin; tell a hit from a miss; prove it with the X-Cache and Age headers.
creative_concept: Follow one request for logo.png from Karachi to an origin in N. Virginia, across a dark glowing world map, then shrink the trip to a single hop once the edge has it.

treatments.name: A. Follow one request across the map, then prove it in a terminal
treatments.shape: globe hook, map problem, map network, iconflow path, compare hit/miss, sequence on miss, terminal proof, stacking benefits
treatments.verdict: Chosen because it pairs a concrete geography with a verifiable proof at the end.

treatments.name: B. Abstract cache theory with charts
treatments.shape: hit ratio charts and TTL timelines
treatments.verdict: Rejected: needs numbers we cannot source and loses the real path.

treatments.name: C. Pure sequence diagram walkthrough
treatments.shape: one long sequence diagram for every step
treatments.verdict: Rejected: precise but static for 60 s on a phone; no sense of geography.

chosen: A. Follow one request across the map, then prove it in a terminal
hook: Why does a site in Virginia load fast in Karachi? A glowing globe with edge points, the question in large type in the first second.
narrative_structure: Question; the distance problem; the edge network with sourced counts; the request path; hit versus miss; what happens on a miss; terminal proof with X-Cache and Age; three benefits and the answer to the hook.
visual_direction: noir-network throughout, rebuilt from the dark map references: glowing land, pulsing hubs, callout cards, legend, stat strip with sourced numbers only; diagrams with drawn-on connectors and packets with trails.
narration_approach: Calm and exact, one idea per sentence, real names (CloudFront, edge location, regional edge cache, X-Cache, Age).
